candidates.claim: sw-ot-01 is configured to send logs from its MGMT address 10.10.99.11 to CORP host 192.168.30.95, a flow between the OT side and CORP that is not among the approved cross-zone services.
candidates.remediation: Remove the logging host 192.168.30.95 from sw-ot-01 and point logging to the MGMT syslog server 10.10.99.60.

candidates.claim: sw-ot-01 has a logging destination 192.168.30.95 outside MGMT, while the management policy requires logging destinations to be inside MGMT 10.10.99.0/24.
candidates.remediation: Replace 192.168.30.95 with the MGMT syslog server 10.10.99.60 or remove the line.

candidates.claim: The logging host 192.168.30.95 on sw-ot-01 is an addition to the approved baseline in the global section and must be reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the added logging host against the approved baseline and remove it unless an approved change record exists.
